mapper.sql: SELECT e.JOB_EXECUTION_ID AS jobExecutionId, i.JOB_INSTANCE_ID AS jobInstanceId, i.JOB_NAME AS jobName, e.STATUS AS status, e.EXIT_CODE AS exitCode, e.EXIT_MESSAGE AS exitMessage, e.CREATE_TIME AS createTime, e.START_TIME AS startTime, e.END_TIME AS endTime, COALESCE(s.readCount, 0) AS readCount, COALESCE(s.writeCount, 0) AS writeCount, COALESCE(s.skipCount, 0) AS skipCount, COALESCE(s.stepCount, 0) AS stepCount FROM BATCH_JOB_EXECUTION e JOIN BATCH_JOB_INSTANCE i ON i.JOB_INSTANCE_ID = e.JOB_INSTANCE_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT JOB_EXECUTION_ID, SUM(READ_COUNT) AS readCount, SUM(WRITE_COUNT) AS writeCount, SUM(READ_SKIP_COUNT + PROCESS_SKIP_COUNT + WRITE_SKIP_COUNT) AS skipCount, COUNT(*) AS stepCount FROM BATCH_STEP_EXECUTION GROUP BY JOB_EXECUTION_ID) s ON s.JOB_EXECUTION_ID = e.JOB_EXECUTION_ID
mapper.select: ORDER BY e.JOB_EXECUTION_ID DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BATCH_JOB_EXECUTION e JOIN BATCH_JOB_INSTANCE i ON i.JOB_INSTANCE_ID = e.JOB_INSTANCE_ID
